item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las gnod sbyin gzhan gyi mi thub pas rlung sgrub myur mgyogs glog zhags
item.coloph: ces gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rlung sgrub myur mgyogs glog gi zhags pa 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i rnam 'byor kun grol grags pa'i dpal gyi (gyis) rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyis (gyi) gtsug lag chen po ngo mtshar (nor) bu'i gling du/ khro chen rgyal po'i (pos) zhabs bstis ches cher mdzad pa bzhin du bstan pa bsrung ba'i lag char bsngags pa 'di pa/ me 'brug hor zla brgyad pa'i dmar phyogs su bgyis so//
